run_distributed_training: run a function across multiple GPU processes using PyTorch distributed init and NCCL backend
run_multi_machine_training: run a training function across multiple machines using shard IDs and process groups
run_with_output_queue: run a distributed function and return results from the master process via an output queue
run_with_tcp_init: run a distributed function using TCP initialization method for process group setup
run_with_filesystem_init: run a distributed function using shared file-system initialization for process group setup
